accepted.quote: This bill represents a step in the wrong direction for America. The Republican majority's Fiscal Year 2026 appropriations bill for the Subcommittee on Transportation, Housing and Urban Development and Related Agencies (T-HUD) cuts discretionary spending by $6 million, or 6 percent, for critical transportation, housing, and community development programs.
accepted.rationale: The passage characterizes the FY2026 T-HUD appropriations bill as the wrong direction and criticizes its spending cuts.
